source_snapshot.test_set: AMD CPU RAS -PCIe ACS Fatal Error
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Place an ACS-capable NIC in the target OCP path, enable AMD PCIe fatal-error handling, inject `errortype 4` at a signed socket/die/NBIO/core/port tuple, observe immediate warm reset and verify the new fatal error through post-boot BERT/dmesg.
procedure_facts: Verify configuration and establish a log boundary.
Install an ECC RDIMM and target NIC and provide HDT.
Apply six ACS/AER/severity/SyncFlood BIOS settings and unlock via HDT.
Boot Ubuntu 20.04 or the ambiguous `RHEL 2022`, enumerate with `--listpcieslotinfo`, then run one fixed tuple `0:0:1/core3/port0` with errortype 4.
Expect immediate reset, reboot and post-boot dmesg inspection.
criteria_facts: The fatal error is logged correctly in BERT/dmesg after warm reset.
The OS reports within a defined timeout.
Linux lspci shows that the device is ACS-capable.
source_conflicts: Items require OCP slots 1~N, but the procedure provides one fixed target tuple and no iteration or NIC relocation/population plan.
The supported environment label `RHEL 2022` is not a precise RHEL release identifier.
missing_source_information: Whether one ACS-capable NIC is moved between slots or each slot is prepopulated.
Where ACS capability must be present and which lspci capability fields are accepted.
Exact tool build/errortype-4 semantics, BERT/CPER signature, timeout and per-slot record freshness method.

original_test_intent.statement: For every required OCP slot, inject the approved AMD PCIe ACS fatal condition into an ACS-capable NIC path, verify the immediate warm reset and a new target-correlated BERT/CPER fatal record after reboot, and confirm recovery and final health.
must_preserve: AMD ACS fatal `errortype 4`, not correctable, non-fatal, LCRC, ECRC or poisoned-TLP variants.
ACS capability check, exact target tuple and immediate reset.
must_not_infer: That the fixed 0:0:1/core3/port0 tuple applies to every slot.
That any lspci ACS text proves the required endpoint/upstream ACS behavior.
That an old BERT record proves the current injection.
That reboot success alone establishes correct target or error evidence.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly preserves ACS capability, the source tuple validation, immediate reset, BERT/dmesg evidence, manual installation/BIOS/HDT boundaries and fatal recovery.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 rewrites the 1~N title as one approved OCP slot, lacks per-slot NIC population/tuple iteration and does not require proof that each post-boot BERT record is new and tied to the just-injected slot.

related_records: Intel OCP UCE and AMD OCP correctable/non-fatal/fatal/LCRC/ECRC/poisoned-TLP rows are distinct and cannot supply this ACS-fatal tuple or evidence.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The exact XLSX row controls ACS fatal intent; adjacent same-title variants are excluded and the 1~N/procedure gap requires owner mapping.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep the gated hybrid class, restore complete OCP 1~N coverage and require a signed NIC/ACS/target tuple per slot plus a fresh post-reset BERT/CPER correlation method. Physical relocation, BIOS/HDT and recovery remain manual; bounded injection and evidence capture may be automated after approval.

conditions_present: The fatal ACS mode, candidate command, six BIOS settings, immediate-reset behavior and post-boot BERT evidence family are known.
missing: Full OCP matrix and population/relocation plan; exact ACS-capability locus; OS/kernel; tool build; BERT signature/freshness and timeout; per-slot approval, recovery and final-state policy.
provider: Platform owner supplies physical OCP/NIC/topology/tuple and ACS-capability matrices.
AMD/ODM FAE supplies tool/errortype-4, expected BERT/CPER and reset semantics.
Lab owner supplies qualified physical work, authorization, isolated network state and recovery window.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory OCP slots, NIC part/serial/firmware/BDF/link/network role and upstream topology.
Capture `lspci -vv` capability and `--listpcieslotinfo` only if the signed tool declares enumeration non-mutating.
Export current BERT/APEI/dmesg, BMC/firmware, reset history and BIOS values without clearing or changing them.
prohibited_until_resolved: NIC/RDIMM relocation while powered, BIOS changes, HDT unlock, log/record clear, fatal injection, manual reset, power cycle, retry or restoration.
closure_evidence: Every slot has a signed physical/NIC/BDF/upstream/target tuple and population or ESD-safe relocation step.
The selected Linux release/kernel and ACS capability fields are defined.
The approved recipe defines a new-record correlation method, timeout, immediate-reset timeline, recovery and restoration.

revision_candidate.test_name: AMD OCP Slot 1~N PCIe ACS Fatal Injection and BERT Recovery
revision_candidate.purpose: For every required OCP slot, inject one approved ACS fatal condition into the exact ACS-capable NIC path, verify the expected immediate warm reset and new target-correlated BERT/CPER evidence after boot, then confirm NIC/link/system recovery.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the AMD server, BIOS/BMC/firmware, ECC RDIMM population, exact Ubuntu 20.04 or owner-specified RHEL release/kernel, ACS-capable NIC(s), HDT method and AMD RAS tool build covered by the signed recipe.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every populated and explicitly required OCP slot 1~N in the signed matrix, sequentially. Each row binds physical slot/label, NIC part/serial/BDF, upstream port, ACS-capability locus and socket/die/NBIO/core/port tuple. If one NIC is moved, each move is a separate powered-off manual phase. Exclude ordinary PCIe and all non-ACS/correctable/non-fatal/ECRC/LCRC/poisoned-TLP variants. Treat 30/60 minutes as estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: N and signed OCP/NIC/BDF/upstream/target matrix; NIC population or relocation/ESD plan; accepted lspci ACS fields and locus; exact tool build/hash and errortype-4 semantics; six BIOS values/restore plan; exact Linux/kernel; expected BERT/CPER severity/PCIe identity and new-record correlation; timeout; warm-reset/boot/recovery timeline; approval and final-state plan.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent:
Before each slot, retain and hash BERT/APEI/dmesg, BMC, firmware and reset baselines or apply the approved freshness marker. A qualified operator powers down for any NIC movement, establishes the signed population, applies the six BIOS settings and HDT unlock, then boots the signed Linux build. Verify NIC identity/link, ACS fields and `--listpcieslotinfo` against the row. After per-slot approval, execute one exact `--pcieerror --sockdienbio --errortype 4 --pciecore --pcieport

` command, observe rather than interrupt the expected immediate warm reset, and after boot collect the new BERT/CPER/dmesg record and device/link/system health before the next go/no-go. Restore all states after the matrix.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Exact per-slot tuple/population and ACS evidence approved; dedicated non-production SUT and isolated/noncritical NIC traffic; BERT support and freshness method verified; exact OS/tool/BIOS/HDT matched; clocks/storage, console/OOB and recovery proven; qualified physical observer; every relocation, BIOS, unlock, clear, injection, reset/recovery and restoration action authorized.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Platform/OS/kernel/tool identities and hashes; signed OCP matrix; NIC part/serial/firmware/BDF/upstream path and physical photos; lspci ACS capability at the required locus; BIOS/HDT before/during/after; baseline/freshness audit; enumeration; exact per-slot command and pre-reset tool output; reset/boot timestamps and reset reason; new BERT/CPER/APEI/dmesg fatal PCIe record decoded to the current target within timeout; required BMC/firmware evidence; post-boot NIC/link/network/system health, anomalies, recovery and restored final state.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The signed AMD/ODM ACS-fatal recipe and platform OCP matrix. ACPI BERT reports unhandled errors from the previous boot through a CPER-compliant boot error record, so each slot requires a fresh current-injection correlation, expected immediate warm reset, timely fatal record and healthy recovery.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Critical fatal PCIe injection on a dedicated SUT only. Do not move powered hardware, infer ACS or tuples, copy the example tuple, target production/boot/management-critical networking, reuse another fault pattern, expose secrets, truncate pre-reset/post-boot evidence, accept stale BERT, manually interrupt the expected reset, auto-loop/retry or continue after wrong target, missing reset/record, boot failure, link/device loss or instability.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Platform owner approves every OCP/NIC/tuple and ACS finding; AMD/ODM FAE approves tool/fatal/reset/BERT semantics; network/lab owner confirms no production dependency. Qualified operator performs power/ESD, BIOS/HDT and exceptional recovery. Every slot injection, next-slot go/no-go and final restoration require signed authorization.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Qualified staff own NIC/RDIMM installation or relocation, BIOS/HDT, physical/reset observation and exceptional recovery. After exact handoff, an authorized Agent may perform enumeration, execute the bounded approved injection and collect/correlate pre-reset/post-boot evidence; engineering retains final anomaly and PASS/FAIL judgment.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong NIC/tuple, absent or unexpected reset, boot timeout, missing/stale/misattributed BERT record, unexpected severity, NIC/link/network loss or persistent AER/fatal state, stop the matrix, preserve all evidence and use only the signed OOB/platform recovery. Power down before hardware changes and restore BIOS/HDT/NIC state before any separately approved rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved slot/population/ACS/tuple or OS; enumeration mismatch; tool/BIOS/HDT mismatch; missing baseline/freshness, approval, timeout, recovery or evidence; non-ACS target; wrong fault/target; no immediate warm reset or unexpected power behavior; failed/late boot; missing, stale or wrong-target BERT/CPER; repeated reset, NIC/link/function loss, persistent error, thermal/power instability; or failed restoration/final health.

identified_defects: V2 reduces OCP slot 1~N to one approved slot and never defines per-slot iteration.
The source's single fixed tuple cannot establish 1~N coverage.
Neither source nor V2 defines a NIC population/relocation method or powered-off boundary for sequential slots.
V2 does not prevent a stale BERT record from being accepted for the next slot.
The exact RHEL release, ACS capability locus and timeout are unspecified.
reason_for_change: Restore all-slot scope and make each fatal injection, reset and previous-boot BERT record independently attributable without weakening physical or recovery controls.

new_technical_evidence.title: ACPI Specification 6.6, Platform Error Interfaces
new_technical_evidence.applicability: BERT evidence explicitly required by the source
new_technical_evidence.supports: The boot error source reports unhandled errors from a previous boot; OSPM reads the firmware-reserved Boot Error Region and records are CPER-compliant. Evidence therefore needs per-reset freshness and target correlation.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The exact platform BERT payload, retention/consumption behavior and clearing method remain firmware-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: Linux Kernel: APEI output format
new_technical_evidence.supports: Linux APEI output exposes severity, section type, flags and PCIe section data; these fields support distinguishing fatal PCIe evidence and correlating the new record.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact kernel version and emitted identifiers for this platform are not specified.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-System RAS-00786-V002
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only the AMD OCP ACS-fatal row
new_technical_evidence.supports: The NIC/HDT requirement, six BIOS settings, example tuple, errortype 4, immediate reset, BERT/dmesg and ACS criteria.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: N, per-slot tuple/population, exact OS, ACS locus, BERT signature and timeout are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Restores every OCP slot and one independent reset/evidence cycle per row.
Defines NIC population versus ESD-safe powered-off relocation as an explicit input.
Separates ACS-capability locus, physical/BDF topology and AMD target tuple.
Requires fresh BERT/CPER correlation and excludes stale records or adjacent fault patterns.
resolved_blockers: Missing tool, platform map, ACS device and operator are provider-closable, so capability stays REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits the complete OCP/NIC/tuple matrix, ACS interpretation, exact OS/tool, fresh BERT evidence policy, timeout, authorization and recovery plan.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 eliminates V2's single-slot scope reduction and makes each of N fatal resets independently targetable and attributable, including safe NIC relocation and stale-BERT prevention.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation recovered every signed OCP matrix row, powered-off relocation boundaries, per-slot tuple remapping, expected immediate warm reset, fresh target-correlated BERT/CPER and full recovery. It rejected stale records, example tuples, reset-only completion, critical networking and automatic iteration/retry.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Reliability row 66 injects AMD ACS fatal errortype 4 into OCP slots 1~N, expects immediate warm reset and post-boot BERT/dmesg, and requires ACS-capable hardware.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 preserves the fatal safety path but collapses 1~N to one slot and lacks relocation and fresh-BERT correlation.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow read-only ACS/topology/BERT baseline work; prohibit relocation, BIOS/HDT/fatal injection until every slot tuple, freshness policy and recovery are signed.
